'''Taergle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] who was rescued by a Rebel working for [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was also the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Deasie A'Fresel]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelFirstLieutenantTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Captain Taergle]]
Taergle was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]] and appearance of Taergle changed each time a player performed this quest. However, the quest dialogue given by C-3PO indicated that Taergle was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Furthermore, the species of Taergle cannot be inferred from his relationship with [[Deasie A'Fresel]], as she too had randomly generated appearances in the game. Therefore, the [[canon]]ical species of Taergle remains unidentified.

Although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, Taergle, identified primarily as Captain Taergle, was also revealed to be a First Lieutenant if examined by the player. This was likely a result of game's character generation mechanics, however while Taergle was most officially recognized as a captain, the possibility of him holding this second rank of First Lieutenant cannot be fully discredited.
